futureProof.psqlAuthority: Same persistent pinned psql/libpq process used for the operation; fixed conninfo metadata plus locked effective verify-full parameters, CA identity, service identity and runtime image. A separate diagnostic connection is not authority for the operation session.
futureProof.certificateSubjectSANFingerprint: Optional only if the reviewed actual client metadata mechanism supplies it; never fabricate it from backend SQL.
futureProof.poolerIdentity: Bind official session endpoint host hash, port 5432, project suffix identity, database postgres, authenticated database role, pinned CA and versioned contract. A shared endpoint certificate alone does not uniquely identify the tenant.
futureProof.parser: Pinned tool version, fixed locale, strict finite parser; unexpected output fails TLS_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE. No password/DSN/raw connection output in public receipts.
futureProof.timing: Validate on every new production session before ledger/catalog or mutation; capture retains RR READ ONLY, one snapshot, ROLLBACK. No downgrade/retry/fallback.
futureProof.dumpLimitation: Current pg_dump/pg_dumpall do not expose the same psql metadata path. A per-tool enforcement attestation can bind exact pinned libpq tool, effective verify-full service/CA hashes and success, but this must be explicitly reviewed as enforced-connection proof, not represented as observed protocol/cipher. If observed per-connection metadata is required, a separately scoped mechanism remains unresolved.

trustBoundaries.between: Operator host/container and provider pooler endpoint
trustBoundaries.operator: Protect existing credential store, lock service and CA, validate actual client TLS and tenant/endpoint identities, deny environment/CLI overrides.
trustBoundaries.provider: Serve the authenticated TLS endpoint and enforce tenant routing/access.
Document applicable upstream authentication, confidentiality/integrity and isolation responsibilities, including any distinct internal transport protection.
trustBoundaries.operator: Approve reviewable assurance tied to this managed service/project class; record evidence identity and review conditions. Do not infer trust from brand or successful login.

acceptFalseOnlyWhen: Same-session client TLS and endpoint validation pass.
Provider assurance explicitly covers the actual managed pooler-to-project trust boundary and explains the non-TLS PostgreSQL observation without an unsupported inference.
The operator explicitly approves the versioned pooled trust contract and evidence identity.
Observed backend metadata matches the approved topology; unknown or conflicting topology fails closed.
evidenceNeeded: Applicable provider architecture/security statement or attributable support response mapping this session-pooler upstream, including authentication, network boundary and encryption/alternative internal protection.
Reviewed reconciliation of the broad DPA assurances with the historical backend ssl=false observation.
Approved per-tool backup proof policy, plus connection capacity/timeouts for the exported-snapshot workflow.
supavisorBinaryIdentity: Not remotely attested. Bind provider-managed service identity and evidence, not an invented server binary hash.
historicalChoiceReason: UNKNOWN; IPv4 suitability is documented, but original project selection intent was not found.

failureModel.CLIENT_TLS_REQUIRED: The actual libpq connection has no TLS; stop before catalog or mutation.
failureModel.CLIENT_CERT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: A verified certificate/hostname validation failure; never infer this detailed cause from an arbitrary stderr string.
failureModel.ENDPOINT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: Fixed hostname/project/database/role/profile or tool identity differs.
failureModel.POOLER_UPSTREAM_TRUST_UNRESOLVED: Missing, expired, inapplicable or unapproved provider-hop assurance.
failureModel.DIRECT_DB_TLS_REQUIRED: Direct backend reports no TLS on the exact session.
failureModel.TLS_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE: Missing, malformed or unsupported client metadata; fail closed, no fallback.
failureModel.TRANSPORT_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: Profile/contract/source/approval identities disagree or wrong topology is selected.
